environment: Tribute 12 sends Tribute 11 sprawling beside the water cache with a trip. Before Tribute 11 can rise, Tribute 12 forces the heavy tank onto the fallen tribute. Tribute 11 dies; Tribute 12 takes water flask.

Tribute 21 falls at the water cache after Tribute 9 catches the approaching tribute’s feet. Tribute 9 pushes the tank off its stand. The crushing injuries are fatal; Tribute 9 leaves with water flask.

Tribute 20 sends Tribute 3 sprawling beside the water cache with a trip. Before Tribute 3 can rise, Tribute 20 forces the heavy tank onto the fallen tribute. Tribute 3 dies; Tribute 20 takes water flask.
At the central water supplies, Tribute 19 trips Tribute 21 beneath the tank’s stand. A shove brings the heavy tank down with fatal force. Tribute 19 collects water flask.
A heavy tank stands over Tribute 1 after Tribute 5 trips the approaching tribute at the water cache. Tribute 5 tips it from the stand, fatally crushing Tribute 1, then gathers water flask.
escape: Tribute 18 closes on the central tool rack just as Tribute 7 pulls an iron bar free. Tribute 7 swings at Tribute 18's head, killing the approaching tribute, then leaves with rescue rope.
The tool rack loses an iron bar as Tribute 5 tears it loose. Before Tribute 16 can get clear, Tribute 5 strikes the head with it. The blow is fatal; Tribute 5 claims rescue rope.

Tribute 4 notices Tribute 5 approaching with a sharpened offcut in The Center Podium. A hard shove on a hanging mesh screen traps the attacking hand; Tribute 4 escapes while the offcut falls on the far side.

Tribute 5 presses a sharpened slat toward Tribute 3's chest in The Center Podium. Tribute 3 turns sideways, taking the point in the shoulder, then traps the slat beneath a foot and escapes while Tribute 5 tries to free it; the shoulder keeps bleeding.
Tribute 5 wrenches a loose iron bar from the central tool rack and strikes Tribute 12 in the head. The blow kills Tribute 12; Tribute 5 takes rescue rope.
weapon: Tribute 6 notices the shadow of the spear across a low wall in The Center Podium before Tribute 14 thrusts the spear toward Tribute 6; a quick backward step leaves Tribute 6 untouched.

Tribute 23 kneels to free a boot snag in The Center Podium as Tribute 22 strikes Tribute 23's thigh with the wooden club, tearing the skin against a jagged edge; abandoning the snagged clothing, Tribute 23 crawls through a fence gap with the thigh still bleeding.
Tribute 4 notices the shadow of the wooden club across a low wall in The Center Podium before Tribute 22 swings the wooden club toward Tribute 4; a quick backward step leaves Tribute 4 untouched.

Tribute 5 turns to challenge Tribute 14 in an exposed lane in The Center Podium, where Tribute 14 thrusts the spear into Tribute 5's shoulder; Tribute 5 throws a loose outer sleeve across the approach and runs clear with a bleeding shoulder.

Tribute 23 strikes Tribute 9's shoulder with the wooden club, tearing the skin against a jagged edge during a confrontation beside an empty crate in The Center Podium; Tribute 9 drops the crate's loose lid across the path and retreats, alive with the shoulder wound untreated.
unusedWeapon: A loose panel momentarily separates Tribute 23 from Tribute 22 in The Center Podium. Tribute 23 takes wooden club through the gap below, but Tribute 22 looks around its edge before the theft is hidden.

Tribute 14 crouches to look into the drainage shaft in The Center Podium. Tribute 9 approaches from behind and lifts the ankles, tipping Tribute 14 headfirst into a fatal fall. Earlier, Tribute 1 died at the drainage shaft. Now Tribute 14 has died at that same spot.

Tribute 5 and Tribute 23 grapple for the higher end of a rubble ridge in The Center Podium. Tribute 5 gives up the height to pull Tribute 23 down onto an exposed reinforcement spike, causing a fatal chest wound.

At a low partition in The Center Podium, Tribute 16 reaches across while Tribute 22 inspects the other side and takes bow and arrows. The missing weight makes Tribute 22 turn in time to see the culprit.

Tribute 16 releases an arrow toward Tribute 9 during an argument at a shelter entrance in The Center Podium; Tribute 9 slams the door across the attack and leaves through its rear gap without a bow and arrows injury.
selfDeaths: Tribute 8 attempts to lower the loose cover across the drainage shaft in The Forest to make a crossing. The cover slips during the lift and drags Tribute 8 over the rim to a fatal landing.
Tribute 3 takes a narrow mountain ledge beneath an unstable scree slope. Falling stones knock them off the path, and the fall is fatal.

A discarded sack hangs from a fitting inside the drainage shaft in The Forest. Tribute 8 climbs down to inspect it, but the fitting breaks away; the fall to the bottom kills them. Tribute 8's death adds another name to the drainage shaft, where Tribute 7 died before.
Tribute 5 steps onto loose leaves in The Swamp and falls into a hidden trail pit. A stake strikes the chest; Tribute 5 dies from the wound.
While Tribute 6 searches a cracked stairwell in the Center Podium, the landing separates from the wall. Tribute 6 falls into the basement and dies on impact.

methodology.rounds: Unique phase indices, including opening and finale; zero-death phases count. Day/night rates use only the corresponding phase kind, excluding finale.
methodology.length: Final calendar day, not wall-clock play time. Finale assignment rounds can share a calendar day.
methodology.loot: Acquisition facts, including gifts and recovery; not just newly created items.
methodology.movement: Passages and individual move facts reported separately. Opening departures, forced weather/closure departures, voluntary noncombat travel and encounter/finale movement are disjoint. Combat-to-travel ratio uses day/night fights and voluntary passages.
methodology.combat: Combat records use authored template and wording-variant metadata plus committed effects, never keyword inference. Variant index identifies the selected authored method. Inventory weapon use includes held weapons and arena charges possessed before the attack; weapons seized during a fight are reported separately. Outcome death/injury/unharmed is mutually exclusive; injury uses newly applied bleeding markers. Unknown methods remain explicit. Legacy keyword estimates are retained only in raw totals and fightExamples; metrics use structured records.
methodology.repetitions: Exact full passages after masking player and region names; events and interviews separate. Within-game repeats exclude the first occurrence in each game. No fragment or semantic matching.
methodology.seeds: Each batch uses seed-0 through seed-(completed-1). Lore disabled. Cast and settings are recorded per batch.
